operators.A: Reference structured operator used by the experiment (the live FMM operator in the saved-sample sweeps).
operators.R: I - B A; this is the left inverse residual, not I - A B.

interpretations.compression_relerr_2: Spectral compression error relative to the reference operator norm; not a bound on relative matvec error for every input vector.
interpretations.solve_residual_relerr_fro: RMS relative solution error over isotropic unit solution vectors x, with right-hand sides b = A x; not an average over arbitrary right-hand sides.
interpretations.solve_residual_norm_2: Worst-direction relative solution error for b = A x, estimated rather than certified; ||I||_2 = 1, so no sqrt(n) normalization is applied.

estimation.frobenius_method: Ratio of Frobenius estimates from independent-of-training real Gaussian test vectors.
estimation.probe_source: Fresh ChaCha8Rng evaluation probes, not saved training Omega/Psi columns; distinct fixed seeds for G and H.
estimation.spectral_method: Square roots of power-iteration Rayleigh estimates for E^* E, A^* A and R^* R, where E = A - A_tilde, using implemented adjoints.
estimation.caveat: Finite-probe and finite-iteration estimates. Adjoint consistency and convergence must be checked before claiming spectral accuracy; see adjoint_consistency_error_inv.

raw_field_definitions.norm_apply_fro: Unnormalized Frobenius compression error estimate; divide by norm_a_fro.
raw_field_definitions.norm_a_fro: Frobenius norm estimate of the reference operator.
raw_field_definitions.norm_apply_2: Unnormalized spectral compression error estimate; divide by norm_a_2.
raw_field_definitions.norm_a_2: Spectral norm estimate of the reference operator.
raw_field_definitions.err_solve_fro: Unnormalized Frobenius inverse-residual estimate; divide by sqrt(dim).
raw_field_definitions.err_solve_2: Already the spectral inverse-residual estimate; do not divide by sqrt(dim).
raw_field_definitions.solve_error_rhs: A separate sampled relative solution error, ||B A x - x||_2 / ||x||_2; not a matrix norm.

scope: Algebraic coefficient-space errors against the reference operator, not PDE discretization errors.
null_value_meaning: Unavailable because an input is nonfinite, negative, or its normalization denominator is zero.
